terms.title: Terms & Privacy Policy
terms.intro: Last updated: October 24, 2023. Please review these terms carefully as they govern your use of the LEGASH platform.
terms.dataP1: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This section explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our services. We only collect data necessary to provide and improve the LEGASH experience.
terms.dataP2: Your health information, including blood type and donation history, is encrypted and stored securely. We adhere strictly to national health data regulations to ensure your sensitive information remains confidential.
terms.usageP1: LEGASH does not sell your personal data to third parties. Your information is only shared when necessary to facilitate a blood donation request or to comply with legal obligations.
terms.usageP2: When you respond to a donation request, your contact details may be shared with the requesting party or the partner hospital, only with your explicit consent for that specific transaction.
terms.verificationP1: To ensure the safety and integrity of the LEGASH community, all accounts must undergo a verification process. This may involve confirming your phone number, email address, or identity via government-issued ID.
terms.verificationP2: Unverified accounts may face restrictions in interacting with active requests or making direct contact with other users.
terms.responsibilitiesP1: By using this app, you agree to provide accurate and up-to-date health information. You acknowledge that providing false information regarding your donation eligibility can have serious medical consequences.
terms.responsibilityB1: Maintain the confidentiality of your account credentials.
terms.responsibilityB2: Respect the privacy and circumstances of other users.
terms.responsibilityB3: Report any suspicious activity or violations of these terms immediately.
